Selling process

Frequently asked questions

Questions commonly asked by people selling cars through Cars24 UAE.

What is the process of selling my car?

Cars24 guides you from appointment booking and inspection through ownership transfer and payment processing.

How much time does it take to sell my car with Cars24?

The initial online evaluation can be quick, while inspection, transfer, and payment depend on the chosen route and document readiness.

Can I sell any car at Cars24?

Cars24 typically focuses on eligible GCC-spec, non-commercial vehicles and may route some cases through channel partners or trade-in support.

Can I trade or exchange my car?

Yes. Exchange support is available, and the team can help you continue from booking toward the next purchase.
